text: Want to be financially ahead by thirty?
Start by finding where your money leaks.
Step one: run a money leak audit.
Go through your last three months of bank statements.
Circle every subscription, fee and impulse buy you forgot about.
My free money leak audit workbook walks you through it.
Step two: build a starter emergency fund.
Start with one month of bills, then build to three.
Step three: pay off high-interest debt, like credit cards, before you invest.
Set up an automatic transfer on payday, even a small amount.
A thousand dollars at seven percent could grow to over seven thousand dollars in thirty years.
Grab the free money leak audit workbook.
